title: Rutile settings
description: Every setting of the shell (D45). The shell reads $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/rutile/settings.json and managed.json against this schema; the home-manager module builds its options from it.

speed.title: Animation speed
speed.description: How fast every animation runs: 1 is Material's speed, 2 twice as fast, 0 turns motion off.

pins.title: Pinned apps
pins.description: Desktop entry ids pinned to the shelf, in order. Unset: the first installed file manager, browser and terminal.

sound.title: Notification sound
sound.description: Play a sound when a notification pops up (with pw-play): the sender's sound, or the sound theme's message sound. Never in Do not disturb, except for critical ones.

path.title: Wallpaper image
path.description: The wallpaper's image file (absolute path), shown on every screen; the lock screen shows it blurred. Unset: a plain surface.

palette.title: Colors from the wallpaper
palette.description: Render the shell's palette from the wallpaper whenever it changes (matugen).

idleMinutes.title: Lock when idle
idleMinutes.description: Lock after this many minutes without input; 0 never. Apps that inhibit idle (a playing video) keep it unlocked.

beforeSleep.title: Lock before sleep
beforeSleep.description: Lock when the computer suspends or hibernates, so it wakes up locked.

enabled.title: Colors in other apps
enabled.description: Give other apps the shell's colors (matugen) whenever the palette changes. Each app has its own switch; off takes the colors back out.

niri.title: niri
niri.description: Window borders, focus ring, tab indicators and the overview's backdrop: a rutile-colors.kdl that niri includes (the home-manager module adds the include).

gtk.title: GTK apps
gtk.description: GTK 3 and 4 apps (Nautilus and the like): a rutile.css that gtk.css imports.

qt.title: Qt apps
qt.description: qt5ct and qt6ct's color scheme (Qt apps that use them).

kitty.title: kitty
kitty.description: kitty's background, foreground, selection, cursor and tabs; reloads at once.

ghostty.title: Ghostty
ghostty.description: Ghostty's background, foreground, selection and cursor (theme = rutile).

btop.title: btop
btop.description: btop's colors (color_theme = rutile; your previous theme comes back when this is off).

nvim.title: Neovim
nvim.description: A rutile colorscheme for Neovim; choose it with :colorscheme rutile.

firefox.title: Firefox
firefox.description: Firefox through the Pywalfox extension, with Rutile's own host: no pywalfox program needed. Install the extension in Firefox.

agent.title: Ask for passwords
agent.description: Be the session's polkit agent: apps that need an administrator's permission ask for the password in the shell. Turn off when another agent does it.
